# package resolver

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/resolver"
```

Package resolver resolves references and model paths against a namespace profile, from a logical node class through data objects, sub data objects and CDCs down to data attributes, constructed types and basic or enumerated leaf types:

	MMXU → Hz (MV) → mag (AnalogueValue) → f (FLOAT32)
	MMXU → PNV (WYE) → phsA (CMV) → cVal (Vector) → mag → f

Inherited data objects are found through the base classes of the logical node class. Attributes of parameterized CDCs, such as stVal of ENS, take the underlying type of their data object. When a functional constraint is given, every data attribute on the path must have it.

Every [Step](#type-step) of a [Resolution](#type-resolution) records the class, CDC or type that declares it and the namespace that defines that, so results keep their provenance. Unknown elements fail with a [\*model.ResolutionError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ResolutionError); nothing degrades to an anonymous generic type. Names that the lookup cannot resolve unambiguously fail with a [\*model.AmbiguityError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#AmbiguityError).

A successful resolution means the path is valid in the normative model. It does not mean that a device implements it: optional data objects and attributes may be absent, which only SCL or discovery can tell.

## Constants

```go
const DefaultMaxDepth = 32
```

DefaultMaxDepth bounds the nesting depth the resolver follows when it expands data objects and constructed types.

## Functions

### func IsMultiInstance

```go
func IsMultiInstance(p model.PresenceCondition) bool
```

IsMultiInstance reports whether a presence condition allows numbered instances of a data object: Mmulti, Omulti, MmultiRange, OmultiRange or MmultiF.

A bare name without an instance number also resolves: the Data-Instance-ID of IEC 61850-7-2:2010 §22.2 is optional.

```go
type Lookup interface {
	LogicalNode(name string) (*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
	Inheritance(name string) ([]*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
	DataObject(lnClass, name string) (catalog.InheritedDataObject, error)
	DataObjects(lnClass string) ([]catalog.InheritedDataObject, error)
	CDC(name string) (*model.CommonDataClass, error)

	Enumeration(name string) (*model.Enumeration, error)
	BasicType(name string) (*model.BasicType, error)

	// Qualified lookups: the definition of one namespace.
	LogicalNodeIn(ns model.NamespaceID, name string) (*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
	InheritanceIn(ns model.NamespaceID, name string) ([]*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
	DataObjectIn(ns model.NamespaceID, lnClass, name string) (catalog.InheritedDataObject, error)
	DataObjectsIn(ns model.NamespaceID, lnClass string) ([]catalog.InheritedDataObject, error)

	// Scoped lookups: a name referenced from a definition of namespace
	// from, resolved in that namespace and its dependencies first.
	CDCVariantsFrom(from model.NamespaceID, name string) ([]*model.CommonDataClass, error)
	ConstructedAttributeFrom(from model.NamespaceID, name string) (*model.ConstructedAttribute, error)
	EnumerationFrom(from model.NamespaceID, name string) (*model.Enumeration, error)
	BasicTypeFrom(from model.NamespaceID, name string) (*model.BasicType, error)
}
```

Lookup is the set of lookups the resolver needs. \*catalog.Profile implements it, and so does \*catalog.Catalog, whose lookups fail on names that several loaded namespaces define.

### type Resolution

```go
type Resolution struct {
	// Steps lists every element of the path; the first is the logical

	Steps []Step `json:"steps"`

}
```

Resolution is a resolved model path, from a logical node class down to a data object or data attribute.

### type Resolver

```go
type Resolver struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Resolver resolves references and model paths against a [Lookup](#type-lookup), usually a namespace profile. It is safe for concurrent use.

The logical node class of a path is looked up unqualified, unless the resolver is restricted to a namespace with [Resolver.In](#func-resolver-in). Every other reference (CDCs, constructed types, enumerations, basic types, base classes) is resolved in the scope of the namespace that declares it, so a name that two namespaces define does not make paths through the other one ambiguous.

#### func New

```go
func New(l Lookup) *Resolver
```

New returns a resolver for the given lookup.

#### func (Resolver) In

```go
func (r *Resolver) In(ns model.NamespaceID) *Resolver
```

In returns a resolver that looks up logical node classes in namespace ns only, e.g. DBAT as IEC 61850-7-420 defines it when IEC TR 61850-90-9 defines DBAT too. The ID may be partial ("IEC 61850-7-420").

#### func (Resolver) Leaves

```go
func (r *Resolver) Leaves(lnClass string, path []string, fc model.FunctionalConstraint) ([]*Resolution, error)
```

Leaves expands a model path into every attribute leaf below it: the basic, enumerated and other non-constructed attributes, with constructed types expanded. An empty path expands every data object of the class, including inherited ones. When fc is set, only data attributes with that functional constraint are followed.

Leaves are returned in model order: data objects in class order, members of a CDC or constructed type in document order.

#### func (Resolver) Resolve

```go
func (r *Resolver) Resolve(ref reference.Ref) (*Resolution, error)
```

Resolve resolves an instance reference, e.g. "LD0/MMXU1.Hz.mag.f\[MX]", through the logical node class of its instance name. The logical device is not checked: the catalog describes classes, not devices.

#### func (Resolver) ResolveAttribute

```go
func (r *Resolver) ResolveAttribute(lnClass, dataObject string, attrPath ...string) (*Resolution, error)
```

ResolveAttribute resolves the attribute path below a data object of a logical node class, e.g. ("MMXU", "Hz", "mag", "f").

ResolveCDC returns the CDC with the given name.

```go
func (r *Resolver) ResolveInheritance(lnClass string) ([]*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
```

ResolveInheritance returns the class chain of a logical node class, from the class itself to its root class.

#### func (Resolver) ResolvePath

```go
func (r *Resolver) ResolvePath(lnClass string, path []string, fc model.FunctionalConstraint) (*Resolution, error)
```

ResolvePath resolves a path of data object and attribute names below a logical node class. When fc is set, every data attribute on the path must have that functional constraint, and a path that ends at a data object must contain at least one attribute with it.

Errors wrap [model.ErrUnknownLogicalNode](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownLogicalNode), [model.ErrUnknownDataObject](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownDataObject), [model.ErrUnknownCDC](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownCDC), [model.ErrUnknownAttribute](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownAttribute), [model.ErrUnknownType](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrUnknownType), [model.ErrCycle](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrCycle) or [model.ErrAmbiguousReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrAmbiguousReference).

#### func (Resolver) ResolveString

```go
func (r *Resolver) ResolveString(s string) (*Resolution, error)
```

ResolveString parses s as an instance reference when it contains "/" and as a class reference otherwise, and resolves it.

### type Step

```go
type Step struct {
	Name string   `json:"name"`
	Kind StepKind `json:"kind"`
	// Type is the class of a logical node step, the CDC of a data
	// object step, and the resolved type of an attribute step.
	Type string `json:"type"`
	// TypeKind is the resolved type kind of an attribute step.
	TypeKind model.TypeKind `json:"typeKind,omitempty"`
	// FC is the functional constraint of an attribute step; sub data
	// attributes carry the FC of their data attribute.
	FC       model.FunctionalConstraint `json:"fc,omitempty"`
	Presence model.PresenceCondition    `json:"presence,omitzero"`
	IsArray  bool                       `json:"isArray,omitempty"`
	// Instance is the instance number of a numbered data object, e.g.
	// "1" for Ind1 of the multi-instance data object Ind.
	Instance string `json:"instance,omitempty"`
	// Index is the array element index of an indexed path element,
	// e.g. "3" for phsAHar(3) (IEC 61850-7-2:2010 §6.1.2.3). Name keeps
	// the element as written, with the index.
	Index string `json:"index,omitempty"`
	// Variant is the CDC variant that declares a data attribute, e.g.
	// "SG" for setVal of SPG/SG.
	Variant string `json:"variant,omitempty"`
	// Variants lists the alternative definitions of a data attribute
	// with different FCs ("SPG/SG.setVal", "RST._setMag"), when no FC
	// was requested; FC is then empty because it depends on the
	// realization. Request an FC to select one.
	Variants []string `json:"variants,omitempty"`
	// Parameterized reports that the type was taken from the underlying
	// type of the enclosing data object (e.g. ENS.stVal).
	Parameterized bool `json:"parameterized,omitempty"`
	// DeclaredIn is the class, CDC or constructed type that declares
	// the element.
	DeclaredIn string `json:"declaredIn"`
	// Source is the namespace of DeclaredIn.
	Source model.NamespaceID `json:"source"`
	// Doc is the documentation of the element: its IDs and, when an
	// NSDoc or a doc set was applied to the namespace (for example with
	// official.DefaultDocumented), its title and description. Control
	// service structures and their fixed parameters have none.
	Doc model.Doc `json:"doc,omitzero"`
}
```

Step is one element of a resolved path.
